sloka: स तु मर्मणि घोरेण ताडितो मन्मथेषुणा ।न शर्म लभते रामः सिंहार्दित इव द्विपः ।। ५.३९.५१।।।।
transliteration: sa tu marmaṇi ghoreṇa tāḍito manmatheṣuṇā ।na śarma labhate rāmaḥ siṁhārdita iva dvipaḥ ।। 5.39.51।।।।

translations.english: "Rama is tormented by the dreadful arrows of the god of love pierced into vitals, like an elephant hit by a lion. He has no happiness in life.
